crossRefs.note: But if any man thinks that he is behaving inappropriately toward his virgin, if she is past the flower of her age, and…
Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled; but God will judge the sexually immoral and…
Therefore I think that because of the distress that is on us, that it’s good for a man to remain as he is.
But I desire to have you to be free from cares. He who is unmarried is concerned for the things of the Lord, how he may…
This I say for your own profit; not that I may ensnare you, but for that which is appropriate, and that you may attend…
But I call God for a witness to my soul, that I didn’t come to Corinth to spare you.

translations.web: But if you marry, you have not sinned. If a virgin marries, she has not sinned. Yet such will have oppression in the flesh, and I want to spare you.
translations.bsb: But if you do marry, you have not sinned. And if a virgin marries, she has not sinned. But those who marry will face troubles in this life, and I want to spare you this.
translations.kjv: But and if thou marry, thou hast ➔ not sinned; and if a virgin marry, she hath ➔ not sinned. Nevertheless such shall have trouble in the flesh: but I spare you.
translations.asv: But shouldest thou marry, thou hast not sinned; and if a virgin marry, she hath not sinned. Yet such shall have tribulation in the flesh: and I would spare you.
